title: Repair a storage configuration (AWS S3)
description: The reports service fails every storage check although its bucket exists. Find the misconfiguration, point the service at the right bucket, and verify a fresh round trip.

objectives.label: Find the storage error in the service logs or configuration
Point the service at the bucket that holds its reports
Verify a fresh round trip through the service's storage check

hints: Read the api logs: which bucket does the failing storage check use?
Compare it with the buckets listed in the Cloud panel. One letter is missing.
Change the service's storage bucket in the Cloud panel, then run the storage check again. Creating a bucket with the wrong name would hide the real mistake.
solution: Cloud panel: set the api bucket to lab-reports and apply
